papers.title_en: Accelerating Dynamic Route Re-solving via Robust Solver Evolution in Automatic Heuristic Design
papers.authors: Yizhuo Ma, Haoran Sun, Shuang Liang, Muquan Li, Qizhi Chen, Renzhong Wang, Nan Chen, Lunxu Liu, Ke Qin
papers.evidence: 基于大模型的TSP求解器自动启发式设计，提升动态重求解效率
papers.tldr: 多目标路径规划可建模为TSP，基于大模型的自动启发式设计已能构造有效求解器，但当位置变化或请求增删导致数据改变时，已有方法重求解效率低下。该文分析发现静态过拟合会使演化求解器反复陷入重叠的局部邻域，进而提出鲁棒的求解器演化方法以加速动态重求解。该工作属于现代TSP启发式自动设计方向，对理解ATSP的启发式求解有借鉴意义，但未专门讨论非对称情形。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-goal route planning uses spatial data on service locations and pairwise travel costs to determine a visiting order that minimizes total travel cost. This task can be formulated as the traveling salesman problem (TSP) and has benefited from large language model-based automatic heuristic design (AHD) for constructing effective solvers. Despite their effectiveness in static settings, existing methods exhibit substantial re-solving inefficiency when location changes, new requests, or request cancellations alter the underlying request data during execution. Our empirical analysis suggests that ``static-overfitting'' contributes to this inefficiency, as evolved solvers may repeatedly direct search toward overlapping local neighborhoods after dynamic changes. We further find that this ``overfitting'' is associated with limitations in existing evolutionary processes, where lower objective values on some instances coincide with longer solving times. In this paper, we therefore propose ERDR, a plug-and-play framework that integrates two strategies into existing AHD pipelines to guide evolution toward solvers that re-solve dynamically changed instances faster. Specifically, 1) ERDR uses validation-guided reselection to reevaluate candidates on instances excluded from routine evolution, reducing specialization to fixed training instances. 2) ERDR applies runtime robustness-augmented evaluation, supplementing the original evaluation objective of AHD methods with inter-group variability and tail risk in solving time to discourage costly and uneven search. Experiments across multiple TSP scales and dynamic scenarios show that ERDR achieves average re-solving speedups of $2.2\times$ under guided local search and $4.4\times$ under iterated local search.
